plugins.name: studio
plugins.description: A one-person product studio's AI team: orchestrator, architect, release captain, staff PM, test-first QA, engineer, privacy and security, persona UX, positioning and story, and a story-keeper that logs decisions and lessons as they happen.

plugins.name: stakeholder
plugins.description: Before something goes public, simulated readers (recruiter, hiring manager, staff engineer, PM peer and more) guess what they might stop at, with a quote id tied to your quote index and one fix each. Hypotheses to check with real people, not research; advisory only.
